diagnosis.original_evidence: Original vehicle-attached rank and rival sprite/clip native CALL producers can enqueue siblings and reenter other UI producers while post-call tags inherit outer Calc3D2D source.
source_trace: RankMarker_sprani and RankMarker_putClipSprite had stable-root snapshot but omitted preserveNewerExactSince when calling TagAppendedNodes.
RivalMarker_sprani captured only before tails; with no sourceRoots argument it lacked stable-root proof despite RivalMarkerSprani requiring exact bounded queue association.
RegisterSpriteNodeScope already supports PreserveNestedExactSpriteOwner(serial) but omitted caller entry serial for all three original rank source wrappers.
diagnosis.root_cause: A newer nested exact SpriteNode registration could be overwritten by outer rank post-call tagging; rival source also accepted a reattached old tail under a replaced priority root without a stable-root snapshot.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: C++ source material commit 5366b7d7f3dac1d23f75c9df461925719887c35d adds entry-serial guard to rank sprani, rank clip and rival sprani; rival root snapshot; compile-time queue and serial positives/negatives.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: TestVehicleRankNestedQueueOwnership: live sprite+digit siblings; replaced priority root with reused old tail; detached old tail; newer foreign source, same producer, older source and missing serial.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The native queued source carries existing exact render scope/ProjectedMarkerInfo to physical R84 draw; no new broad eye authority is granted. HMD still needed for original reported rank headlock/duplication.

notes: Single coherent native vehicle/rival rank queue ownership source repair. Existing optical failures remain unverified until Quest3/VDXR; this source guard alone does not prove the whole visible rank feature is fixed.
